name: @sma/constants
description: Shared, canonical constants for the Somali Music AI Preservation Platform: genres, regions, languages, instruments. The single source of truth consumed by mobile, web, api, and the research dataset.
//: WHY a raw-TypeScript internal package (main points at src): Turborepo 'just-in-time' packages let every app compile these files with its own toolchain (Metro, Next, tsc), so there is no separate build step to keep in sync and no risk of a stale compiled artifact drifting from source.

scripts.test: echo "@sma/constants: no runtime tests — values are asserted via typecheck" && exit 0
